text: April 22, 2026 - Juǀʼhoan: [ʒuᵑ̊ǀʰwã]), also known as Southern or Southeastern ǃKung, ǃXun, or ǃXunthali, is the southern variety of the ǃKung dialect continuum, spoken in northeastern Namibia and the Northwest District of Botswana by San Bushmen who largely identify themselves as Juǀʼhoansi.

text: October 28, 2024 - Juǀʼhoan is a variety of ǃKung, a member of the Kxʼa or Juu–ǂHoan language family, spoken in northeast Namibia and northwest Bostwana by about 35,000 people, with the majority of speakers, some 30,000 people, in Namibia.
